info.name: NNE SafetyHUB - Incident Management APIs
info.description: Postman collection for NNE SafetyHUB Incident Management module with complete 9-column UI table dropdown filters (Classification, Building, Actual/Potential Severity, HiPo, Investigation Level, Contractor, Status/Stage, and Origin).

request.description: Creates a new incident and logs Stage 1 Heads-Up Notification within 2 hours of occurrence.
Approves Stage 1 Heads-Up Notification by Peer Reviewer or Site HSE Lead.

request.description: Submits Stage 2 Initial Incident Report within 24 hours using multipart/form-data for direct photo file attachment.
Uploads multiple photos (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, PDF) via Multer into ./uploads/incidents/ directory and returns an array of relative image URLs.
Uploads a single photo via Multer into ./uploads/incidents/ directory.
Approves Stage 2 Initial Incident Report.

item.name: Stage 3: Save / Update Investigation Report (< 7 Days SLA)

request.description: Saves Stage 3 Investigation Report with Fishbone cause-effect data, 5 Whys root cause tree, mandatory attachments checklist, and sign-offs.
Reviews and signs off Stage 3 Incident Investigation Report.
Marks the Incident as fully CLOSED with audit trail.
Retrieves complete data for a specific incident across Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, and Action Items.

request.description: Adds a new Immediate or Corrective Action Item to an individual incident.

item.name: ACTION ITEM: Get All Action Items for Incident

request.description: Retrieves list of all action items (Immediate and Corrective) belonging to a specific incident.

item.name: ACTION ITEM: Update Action Item Status & Details

request.description: Updates an existing action item status (PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED), responsible person, target date, or implementation time.
Removes an action item from an incident.
Filters incidents by Classification category (e.g., Environmental Incident, First Aid Injury, Near Miss, etc.).
Filters incidents by Building code/name (e.g. INF-1, JG, MA, NA, NB, NC).
Filters incidents by Actual Severity level (1 Insignificant, 2 Minor, 3 Moderate, 4 Critical, 5 Catastrophic).
Filters incidents by Potential Severity level (1 to 5).
Filters High-Potential (HiPo) events.
Filters incidents by Investigation Depth Level (L1, L2, L3).
Filters incidents by involved Contractor name (e.g., CG Jensen, Give Steel, HRS, Pihl, etc.).
Filters incidents by current pipeline status (HEADS_UP, INITIAL_REPORT, INVESTIGATION, CLOSED).
Filters incidents by Origin ('Direct' or escalated Safety Observation e.g. 'SO-2026-6410').

item.name: Update Action Item Status (PENDING -> IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETED)
